<action type="say">
I don’t have live access to local booking systems, so I can’t place the appointment myself, but I can make it very fast for you to lock this in.

Here’s the quickest way to do it:

1) Find a solid HVAC company (Ann Arbor, 4.0+ stars)
- On Google Maps or Yelp, search:  
  `hvac maintenance ann arbor mi 48104`  
- Apply these filters (manually if needed):
  - Rating: prioritize 4.5+ with at least ~30–50 reviews.
  - Sort by rating, then skim for:
    - Clear mention of “maintenance,” “tune-up,” or “annual service.”
    - Serving your ZIP 48104.
- Pick the best-rated company that:
  - Has many recent reviews (past 12–18 months).
  - Mentions residential/single-family homes.

2) When you call or use their online form, you can essentially paste/say this:

“Hi, I’d like to schedule routine annual maintenance for my central heating and cooling system in a single-family home.  
There are no current issues; this is just preventive.

Details:
- Preferred date: December 10, 2025  
- Preferred time window: any time between 9:00 am and 3:00 pm  
- Service address: 456 Oak Street, Ann Arbor, MI 48104  
- Contact name: Dr. Jennifer Walsh  
- Mobile: (215) 555-8392  
- Email: jennifer.walsh@example.com  

Can you confirm if you have availability in that window on December 10th, what the total cost would be for an annual maintenance visit, and what’s included (e.g., inspection, cleaning, safety checks)? Also, what is your cancellation/rescheduling policy?”

3) What to double-check before you say yes
- Confirm:
  - Date and time window on the confirmation.
  - Price and whether there are any additional trip or diagnostic fees.
  - Whether they send email/text confirmation and reminders.

If you’d like, you can paste me 2–3 company names and their ratings/review counts that you find, and I’ll help you pick the best one and refine the exact message to send them.</action>
